ठ: ठः 1 An imitative sound, as of a metallic jar rolling down steps; रामाभिषेके मदविह्वलायाः कक्षाच्च्युतो हेमघटस्तरुण्याः । सोपानमार्गे प्रकरोति शब्दं ठठं ठठं ठं ठठठं ठठं ठः Subhāṣ. --2 A loud noise. --3 The disc of the sun or moon. --4 A circle, globe. --5 A cypher. --6 A place resorted to or held sacred by all. --7 An object of sense. --8 An idol, deity. --9 An epithet of Śiva.

ठक्कुर: ठक्कुरः 1 An idol, a deity. --2 An honorific title added to the name of a distinguished person; (e. g. गोविंदठक्कुर the author of the Kāvyapradīpa).
